_filtering: DBLP merges multiple researchers named 'Dongming Han'. By default only papers with a known VAG co-author are kept. Add (substring of) title to 'include_low_confidence' to opt-in others; add to 'exclude' to drop. Papers in the 'publications' list below that aren't in DBLP get added on top.
